active_region.dataset: Cheung et al. 2018 MURaM outgoing gray intensity

reconstruction.method: overlapping local MHD tiles on six charts

color_grade.reference: Fixed initial calculated mean limb intensity, including existing gravitational redshift
color_grade.purpose: Fixed amber lanes, golden midtones and warm-white bright granules; no invented spatial structure

atmosphere.optical_depth: Optically thin hot phase; photosphere opaque; cool-phase EUV absorption omitted

export.output: H.264 High / yuv420p / Rec.709 limited / MP4
export.quantization: zscale error diffusion at final 8-bit conversion, not astrophysical texture or added decorative grain
